recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散點圖（CD3 對 CD7），非形態影像；主要藍色族群 CD3 陽性且 CD7 強表現（約 10^2），下方的洋紅色 CD3 陽性族群 CD7 較弱，而左上方綠色 CD3 陰性、CD7 陽性的是 NK 細胞。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot, CD3-PC5.5 (x-axis) versus CD7-APC700 (y-axis), gate labeled [AZ]
Dominant blue CD3-positive population with bright CD7 (up to about 10^2) forming a diagonal cluster
Magenta and red CD3-positive events with dim to negative CD7 below the main cluster
Green CD3-negative, CD7-positive population at upper left, consistent with NK cells
Green/magenta CD3-negative, CD7-negative population near the origin
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot displays CD3 versus CD7 expression within the gated population. The dominant population (blue) co-expresses CD3 and bright CD7, while a smaller CD3-positive population with dim to absent CD7 (magenta/red) lies beneath it. CD3-negative, CD7-positive events consistent with NK cells and a double-negative population are also present. An expanded CD3-positive population with bright CD7 is characteristic of T-prolymphocytic leukemia and argues against Sezary syndrome or ATLL, which typically show CD7 loss.
